body.statement: If \(c<C\), then uniformly over \(\mathcal M\), \(\mathbb E\|\widehat\Gamma_N-\Gamma\|_{\mathrm{op}}=O((\log N)^{-1})\), \(\mathbb E d_H(\Theta_{TY}(\widehat\Gamma_N,\preceq),\Theta_{TY}(\Gamma,\preceq))=O((\log N)^{-1})\), and \(\mathbb E d_H(C_N,\Theta_{TY}(\Gamma,\preceq))=O((\log N)^{-1})\).
body.justification: The theorem quantifies both estimation loss and the excess size of an honest set.
body.gap: The logarithmic covariance rate is known from Belomestny--Trabs--Tsybakov; uniform expected Hausdorff control for the entire causal fiber is not stated there.
body.consumer: It supplies a rate for the minimum absolute compatible effect, a one-Lipschitz IDA ranking summary.
